issue.title: test_prompt_codeblock_highlight_solo_png_snapshot dark theme waits on artifact-kind worker under Full CI
issue.description:
Discovered independently by the lander for sase-1kx.5.3.3 while reviewing publication phase sase-1kx.5.3.3.2 note #2. Both observed CI runs used be73b6021ac29d8fcad2cb897192bc6455a47e2b, with no source change between fail and pass. The epic changes nine other visual fixture files, not this node or its implementation.

Full CI 38683274240, visual job 116275103654 timed out waiting for render convergence after 30s: stable_frames=0/5, frame_digests=[], pending_debouncers=[], pending_workers=['prompt-artifact-ref-kinds:0'], pending_one_shot_timers=[], pending_animations=[]. The dark parametrization passed in same-SHA Full CI 38698824253 visual job 116305071749 (only single_main_paged and Tool Runs cards failed). The exact display node ID containing spaces and an em dash is preserved in the attached evidence artifact; collect the node before rerunning. sase-hx's stale-generation invalidation root is not established by this pending-worker timeout.

Observed pair: 1 failure / 1 pass in full parallel CI. No isolated serial reproduction is claimed. Root cause unproven, so size large is intentional.

Trace why the artifact-kind warm worker remains pending for a codeblock-only fixture under load. Establish whether this is worker lifecycle, fixture isolation, or environmental I/O, then fix the proven cause without weakening convergence or pixel assertions.
